title: पञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 150 · Karna and the rakshasa's illusions

summary.en: Dhritarashtra asks how the rakshasa and Karna fought at night, and Sanjaya tells of the rain of iron wheels, spears and boulders that Ghatotkacha sends. Karna breaks the illusion with the Vayavya weapon and Ghatotkacha is forced to meet him again.
summary.kn: ರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಕ್ಷಸ-ಕರ್ಣರು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿದರೆಂದು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚ ಸುರಿಸುವ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ಚಕ್ರ, ಭರ್ಜಿ, ಬಂಡೆಗಳ ಮಳೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕರ್ಣ ವಾಯವ್ಯಾಸ್ತ್ರದಿಂದ ಮಾಯೆ ಒಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र पूछते हैं कि रात में राक्षस और कर्ण कैसे लड़े, और संजय घटोत्कच की बरसाई लोहे के चक्रों, शक्तियों और शिलाओं की वर्षा बताते हैं। कर्ण वायव्यास्त्र से माया तोड़ता है और घटोत्कच को फिर उससे भिड़ना पड़ता है।
summary.te: రాత్రిలో రాక్షసుడు, కర్ణుడు ఎలా పోరాడారని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు అడుగుతాడు; ఘటోత్కచుడు కురిపించే ఇనుప చక్రాలు, శక్తులు, బండల వర్షాన్ని సంజయుడు చెబుతాడు. కర్ణుడు వాయవ్యాస్త్రంతో మాయను ఛేదిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: இரவில் அரக்கனும் கர்ணனும் எவ்வாறு போரிட்டனர் என்று த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்கிறான்; கடோத்கசன் பொழியும் இரும்புச் சக்கரங்கள், வேல்கள், பாறைகளின் மழையைச் சஞ்சயன் கூறுகிறான். கர்ணன் வாயவ்யாஸ்திரத்தால் மாயையை உடைக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: രാക്ഷസനും കർണ്ണനും രാത്രിയിൽ എങ്ങനെ പൊരുതിയെന്ന് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; ഘടോൽക്കചൻ അയയ്ക്കുന്ന ഇരുമ്പുചക്രങ്ങളുടെയും കുന്തങ്ങളുടെയും പാറകളുടെയും മഴയെക്കുറിച്ച് സഞ്ജയൻ പറയുന്നു. കർണ്ണൻ വായവ്യാസ്ത്രംകൊണ്ട് ആ മായ തകർക്കുന്നു; ഘടോൽക്കചൻ വീണ്ടും അദ്ദേഹത്തെ നേരിടാൻ നിർബന്ധിതനാകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.150; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
यत्र वैकर्तनः कर्णो राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः ।
निशीथे समसज्जेतां तद्युद्धमभवत्कथम् ॥

meaning.en: Where Karna, son of Vikartana, and the rakshasa Ghatotkacha met in the middle of the night, how did that battle go?

verses.text:
कीदृशं चाभवद्युद्धं तस्य घोरस्य रक्षसः ।
रथश्च कीदृशस्तस्य मायाः सर्वायुधानि च ॥

meaning.en: What kind of battle was it with that dreadful rakshasa? What was his chariot like, his illusions and all his weapons?

verses.text:
किंप्रमाणा हयास्तस्य रथकेतुर्धनुस्तथा ।
कीदृशं वर्म चैवास्य कण्ठत्राणं च कीदृशम् ।
पृष्टस्त्वमेतदाचक्ष्व कुशलो ह्यसि संजय ॥

meaning.en: How big were his horses, his chariot banner and his bow? What was his armor like, and his neck guard? Tell me, Sanjaya, for you are skilled when asked.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
लोहिताक्षो महाकायस्ताम्रास्यो निम्नितोदरः ।
ऊर्ध्वरोमा हरिश्मश्रुः शङ्कुकर्णो महाहनुः ॥

meaning.en: He had red eyes, a huge body, a copper-colored face, a sunken belly, bristling hair, a green beard, ears like stakes and a great jaw.

verses.text:
आकर्णाद्दारितास्यश्च तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रः करालवान् ।
सुदीर्घताम्रजिह्वोष्ठो लम्बभ्रूः स्थूलनासिकः ॥

meaning.en: His mouth gaped to his ears, with sharp tusks and a frightful look, a very long copper-colored tongue and lips, long eyebrows and a broad nose.

verses.text:
नीलाङ्गो लोहितग्रीवो गिरिवर्ष्मा भयंकरः ।
महाकायो महाबाहुर्महाशीर्षो महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Dark-limbed, with a red neck, big as a mountain and fearsome, huge-bodied, long-armed, big-headed and very strong.

verses.text:
विकचः परुषस्पर्शो विकटोद्बद्धपिण्डिकः ।
स्थूलस्फिग्गूढनाभिश्च शिथिलोपचयो महान् ॥

meaning.en: He was ugly, rough to the touch, with swollen, protruding calves, large buttocks, a hidden navel and a loose, great frame.

verses.text:
तथैव हस्ताभरणी महामायोऽङ्गदी तथा ।
उरसा धारयन्निष्कमग्निमालां यथाचलः ॥

meaning.en: Wearing ornaments on his hands and armlets, a great illusionist, bearing on his chest a necklace like a garland of flame, he was like a mountain.

verses.text:
तस्य हेममयं चित्रं बहुरूपाङ्गशोभितम् ।
तोरणप्रतिमं शुभ्रं किरीटं मूर्ध्न्यशोभत ॥

meaning.en: On his head shone a golden crown, bright and many-colored, adorned with many figures, shining like an archway.

verses.text:
कुण्डले बालसूर्याभे मालां हेममयीं शुभाम् ।
धारयन्विपुलं कांस्यं कवचं च महाप्रभम् ॥

meaning.en: He wore earrings like the young sun, a fine golden garland, a large bronze armor of great brilliance.

verses.text:
किङ्किणीशतनिर्घोषं रक्तध्वजपताकिनम् ।
ऋक्षचर्मावनद्धाङ्गं नल्वमात्रं महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: He rode a great chariot, a nalva in length, resounding with the sound of hundreds of little bells, with red banners and pennants, its frame covered with bear-skin.

verses.text:
सर्वायुधवरोपेतमास्थितो ध्वजमालिनम् ।
अष्टचक्रसमायुक्तं मेघगम्भीरनिस्वनम् ॥

meaning.en: He stood in it, equipped with all the best weapons, with a garland of banners, with eight wheels and a deep sound like a cloud.

verses.text:
तत्र मातङ्गसंकाशा लोहिताक्षा विभीषणाः ।
कामवर्णजवा युक्ता बलवन्तोऽवहन्हयाः ॥

meaning.en: Strong horses, like elephants, red-eyed and terrifying, of any color and speed at will, drew it.

verses.text:
राक्षसोऽस्य विरूपाक्षः सूतो दीप्तास्यकुण्डलः ।
रश्मिभिः सूर्यरश्म्याभैः संजग्राह हयान्रणे ।
स तेन सहितस्तस्थावरुणेन यथा रविः ॥

meaning.en: His charioteer was a rakshasa, Virupaksha, with a blazing face and earrings. With reins bright as the sun's rays he held the horses in the battle. Together with him he stood like the sun with Aruna.

verses.text:
संसक्त इव चाभ्रेण यथाद्रिर्महता महान् ।
दिवस्पृक्सुमहान्केतुः स्यन्दनेऽस्य समुच्छ्रितः ।
रक्तोत्तमाङ्गः क्रव्यादो गृध्रः परमभीषणः ॥

meaning.en: It was as if a huge mountain were joined to a great cloud. Over his chariot a very tall banner rose touching the sky, bearing a most fearful flesh-eating vulture with a red head.

verses.text:
वासवाशनिनिर्घोषं दृढज्यमभिविक्षिपन् ।
व्यक्तं किष्कुपरीणाहं द्वादशारत्नि कार्मुकम् ॥

meaning.en: Twanging a firm bowstring with a sound like Indra's thunderbolt, he held a bow twelve cubits long and a fist's width wide in the middle.

verses.text:
रथाक्षमात्रैरिषुभिः सर्वाः प्रच्छादयन्दिशः ।
तस्यां वीरापहारिण्यां निशायां कर्णमभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Covering all quarters with arrows as long as a chariot axle, in that night that takes away heroes he came at Karna.

verses.text:
तस्य विक्षिपतश्चापं रथे विष्टभ्य तिष्ठतः ।
अश्रूयत धनुर्घोषो विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः ॥

meaning.en: As he drew his bow, standing firm in the chariot, the bow's sound was heard like a thunderclap.

verses.text:
तेन वित्रास्यमानानि तव सैन्यानि भारत ।
समकम्पन्त सर्वाणि सिन्धोरिव महोर्मयः ॥

meaning.en: Terrified by it, all your armies, Bharata, trembled like the great waves of the sea.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य विरूपाक्षं विभीषणम् ।
उत्स्मयन्निव राधेयस्त्वरमाणोऽभ्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the fearful, ugly-eyed rakshasa advance, Radha's son quickly checked him, smiling as it were.

verses.text:
ततः कर्णोऽभ्ययादेनमस्यन्नस्यन्तमन्तिकात् ।
मातङ्ग इव मातङ्गं यूथर्षभ इवर्षभम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna went at him, each shooting at the other from close by, like an elephant at an elephant, like the bull of a herd at a bull.

verses.text:
स संनिपातस्तुमुलस्तयोरासीद्विशां पते ।
कर्णराक्षसयो राजन्निन्द्रशम्बरयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: A tumultuous clash took place between them, O lord of the people, Karna and the rakshasa, like Indra and Shambara.

verses.text:
तौ प्रगृह्य महावेगे धनुषी भीमनिस्वने ।
प्राच्छादयेतामन्योन्यं तक्षमाणौ महेषुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Taking up their bows with fearful sounds and great force, they covered each other, cutting with great arrows.

verses.text:
ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ।
न्यवारयेतामन्योन्यं कांस्ये निर्भिद्य वर्मणी ॥

meaning.en: Then, with bent-jointed arrows loosed from full-drawn bows, they held each other off, piercing each other's bronze armor.

verses.text:
तौ नखैरिव शार्दूलौ दन्तैरिव महाद्विपौ ।
रथशक्तिभिरन्योन्यं विशिखैश्च ततक्षतुः ॥

meaning.en: Like two tigers with claws or two great elephants with tusks, they cut each other with chariot-darts and arrows.

verses.text:
संछिन्दन्तौ हि गात्राणि संदधानौ च सायकान् ।
धक्ष्यमाणौ शरव्रातैर्नोदीक्षितुमशक्नुताम् ॥

meaning.en: Cutting each other's limbs and fitting arrows, burning in swarms of arrows, they could not even look at each other.

verses.text:
तौ तु विक्षतसर्वाङ्गौ रुधिरौघपरिप्लुतौ ।
व्यभ्राजेतां यथा वारिप्रस्रुतौ गैरिकाचलौ ॥

meaning.en: Their whole bodies were wounded and drenched in floods of blood; they shone like two red-ochre mountains streaming with water.

verses.text:
तौ शराग्रविभिन्नाङ्गौ निर्भिन्दन्तौ परस्परम् ।
नाकम्पयेतामन्योन्यं यतमानौ महाद्युती ॥

meaning.en: With limbs pierced by the points of arrows, piercing each other, those two of great radiance, striving, could not shake each other.

verses.text:
तत्प्रवृत्तं निशायुद्धं चिरं सममिवाभवत् ।
प्राणयोर्दीव्यतो राजन्कर्णराक्षसयोर्मृधे ॥

meaning.en: That night battle went on for a long time, evenly matched, O king, as Karna and the rakshasa played for their lives in the fight.

verses.text:
तस्य संदधतस्तीक्ष्णाञ्शरांश्चासक्तमस्यतः ।
धनुर्घोषेण वित्रस्ताः स्वे परे च तदाभवन् ।
घटोत्कचं यदा कर्णो विशेषयति नो नृप ॥

meaning.en: As Karna fitted sharp arrows and shot them without stop, his own side and the enemy alike were terrified by the sound of his bow; but, O king, Karna could not gain the better of Ghatotkacha.

verses.text:
ततः प्रादुष्करोद्दिव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः ।
कर्णेन विहितं दृष्ट्वा दिव्यमस्त्रं घटोत्कचः ।
प्रादुश्चक्रे महामायां राक्षसः पाण्डुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Then the best of those who know weapons brought out a divine weapon. Seeing Karna's divine weapon, Ghatotkacha, the rakshasa, delight of the Pandavas, brought out great illusion.

verses.text:
शूलमुद्गरधारिण्या शैलपादपहस्तया ।
रक्षसां घोररूपाणां महत्या सेनया वृतः ॥

meaning.en: He was surrounded by a huge army of rakshasas of dreadful form, bearing spears and clubs, with hills and trees in their hands.

verses.text:
तमुद्यतमहाचापं दृष्ट्वा ते व्यथिता नृपाः ।
भूतान्तकमिवायान्तं कालदण्डोग्रधारिणम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him with his great bow raised, like Death coming for beings, holding Time's terrible rod, those kings were afraid.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचप्रमुक्तेन सिंहनादेन भीषिताः ।
प्रसुस्रुवुर्गजा मूत्रं विव्यथुश्च नरा भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Frightened by the lion-roar Ghatotkacha let out, elephants passed urine and men were greatly distressed.

verses.text:
ततोऽश्मवृष्टिरत्युग्रा महत्यासीत्समन्ततः ।
अर्धरात्रेऽधिकबलैर्विमुक्ता रक्षसां बलैः ॥

meaning.en: Then a terrible great rain of stones came all around at midnight, loosed by the stronger forces of the rakshasas.

verses.text:
आयसानि च चक्राणि भुशुण्ड्यः शक्तितोमराः ।
पतन्त्यविरलाः शूलाः शतघ्न्यः पट्टिशास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Iron discs, bhushundis, spears, javelins and tridents fell without a break, and shataghnis and battle-axes.

verses.text:
तदुग्रमतिरौद्रं च दृष्ट्वा युद्धं नराधिपाः ।
पुत्राश्च तव योधाश्च व्यथिता विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that fierce and most dreadful fight, the kings and your sons and warriors, in distress, ran away.

verses.text:
तत्रैकोऽस्त्रबलश्लाघी कर्णो मानी न विव्यथे ।
व्यधमच्च शरैर्मायां घटोत्कचविनिर्मिताम् ॥

meaning.en: There Karna alone, proud of his weapon-power and not agitated, did not tremble, and with arrows destroyed the illusion made by Ghatotkacha.

verses.text:
मायायां तु प्रहीणायाममर्षात्स घटोत्कचः ।
विससर्ज शरान्घोरान्सूतपुत्रं त आविशन् ॥

meaning.en: When the illusion was gone, Ghatotkacha in anger sent dreadful arrows, and they entered the charioteer's son.

verses.text:
ततस्ते रुधिराभ्यक्ता भित्त्वा कर्णं महाहवे ।
विविशुर्धरणीं बाणाः संक्रुद्धा इव पन्नगाः ॥

meaning.en: Then those arrows, smeared with blood, having pierced Karna in the great battle, entered the earth like enraged snakes.

verses.text:
सूतपुत्रस्तु संक्रुद्धो लघुहस्तः प्रतापवान् ।
घटोत्कचमतिक्रम्य बिभेद दशभिः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: But the charioteer's son, enraged, quick-handed and radiant, went past Ghatotkacha and pierced him with ten arrows.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचो विनिर्भिन्नः सूतपुत्रेण मर्मसु ।
चक्रं दिव्यं सहस्रारमगृह्णाद्व्यथितो भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Ghatotkacha, pierced in the vitals by the charioteer's son, in great pain took up a divine thousand-spoked discus.

verses.text:
क्षुरान्तं बालसूर्याभं मणिरत्नविभूषितम् ।
चिक्षेपाधिरथेः क्रुद्धो भैमसेनिर्जिघांसया ॥

meaning.en: Edged with a razor rim, bright as the young sun and adorned with jewels, Bhima's son hurled it at Adhiratha's son, angry and wishing to kill.

verses.text:
प्रविद्धमतिवेगेन विक्षिप्तं कर्णसायकैः ।
अभाग्यस्येव संकल्पस्तन्मोघमपतद्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: Hurled with great force, but flung aside by Karna's arrows, it fell uselessly to the earth like the plan of an unlucky man.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचस्तु संक्रुद्धो दृष्ट्वा चक्रं निपातितम् ।
कर्णं प्राच्छादयद्बाणैः स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his discus brought down, Ghatotkacha, enraged, covered Karna with arrows like Svarbhanu (Rahu) covering the sun.

verses.text:
सूतपुत्रस्त्वसंभ्रान्तो रुद्रोपेन्द्रेन्द्रविक्रमः ।
घटोत्कचरथं तूर्णं छादयामास पत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: The charioteer's son, unshaken, with the prowess of Rudra, Upendra and Indra, quickly covered Ghatotkacha's chariot with feathered arrows.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचेन क्रुद्धेन गदा हेमाङ्गदा तदा ।
क्षिप्ता भ्राम्य शरैः सापि कर्णेनाभ्याहतापतत् ॥

meaning.en: Ghatotkacha, in anger, hurled a mace with golden bands; whirled around, it too was struck by Karna's arrows and fell.

verses.text:
ततोऽन्तरिक्षमुत्पत्य कालमेघ इवोन्नदन् ।
प्रववर्ष महाकायो द्रुमवर्षं नभस्तलात् ॥

meaning.en: Then, leaping into the sky, roaring like a black cloud, the huge-bodied one rained a downpour of trees from the sky.

verses.text:
ततो मायाविनं कर्णो भीमसेनसुतं दिवि ।
मार्गणैरभिविव्याध घनं सूर्य इवांशुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna pierced the illusionist, Bhimasena's son, in the sky with arrows, as the sun with its rays pierces a thick cloud.

verses.text:
तस्य सर्वान्हयान्हत्वा संछिद्य शतधा रथम् ।
अभ्यवर्षच्छरैः कर्णः पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान् ॥

meaning.en: Having killed all his horses and cut his chariot into a hundred pieces, Karna showered arrows like a rain-giving cloud.

verses.text:
न चास्यासीदनिर्भिन्नं गात्रे द्व्यङ्गुलमन्तरम् ।
सोऽदृश्यत मुहूर्तेन श्वाविच्छललितो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Not a space of two finger-widths on his body was left unpierced; in a moment he looked like a porcupine.

verses.text:
न हयान्न रथं तस्य न ध्वजं न घटोत्कचम् ।
दृष्टवन्तः स्म समरे शरौघैरभिसंवृतम् ॥

meaning.en: In the battle we could not see his horses, his chariot, his banner or Ghatotkacha, all covered in floods of arrows.

verses.text:
स तु कर्णस्य तद्दिव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रेण शातयन् ।
मायायुद्धेन मायावी सूतपुत्रमयोधयत् ॥

meaning.en: But he, destroying Karna's divine weapon with his own weapon, fought the charioteer's son with an illusion battle.

verses.text:
सोऽयोधयत्तदा कर्णं मायया लाघवेन च ।
अलक्ष्यमाणोऽथ दिवि शरजालेषु संपतन् ॥

meaning.en: Then he fought Karna with illusion and quickness, unseen, falling in the sky among the nets of arrows.

verses.text:
भैमसेनिर्महामायो मायया कुरुसत्तम ।
प्रचकार महामायां मोहयन्निव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Bhima's son, a great illusionist, by illusion, best of Kurus, made great illusions as if to bewilder him, Bharata.

verses.text:
स स्म कृत्वा विरूपाणि वदनान्यशुभाननः ।
अग्रसत्सूतपुत्रस्य दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि मायया ॥

meaning.en: Making ugly faces with fearful features, he swallowed the divine weapons of the charioteer's son by his illusion.

verses.text:
पुनश्चापि महाकायः संछिन्नः शतधा रणे ।
गतसत्त्वो निरुत्साहः पतितः खाद्व्यदृश्यत ।
हतं तं मन्यमानाः स्म प्राणदन्कुरुपुंगवाः ॥

meaning.en: Again, though huge-bodied, he was cut into a hundred pieces in the battle and seen falling from the sky, lifeless and dispirited; and the best of Kurus, thinking him killed, gave a shout.

verses.text:
अथ देहैर्नवैरन्यैर्दिक्षु सर्वास्वदृश्यत ।
पुनश्चापि महाकायः शतशीर्षः शतोदरः ॥

meaning.en: Then he was seen in new bodies in all the quarters; and again the huge-bodied one with a hundred heads and a hundred bellies

verses.text:
व्यदृश्यत महाबाहुर्मैनाक इव पर्वतः ।
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रो भूत्वा च पुनरेव स राक्षसः ।
सागरोर्मिरिवोद्धूतस्तिर्यगूर्ध्वमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: was seen, mighty-armed, like the mountain Mainaka. Then, becoming thumb-sized, the rakshasa rose up again like a wave of the sea, crosswise and upward.

verses.text:
वसुधां दारयित्वा च पुनरप्सु न्यमज्जत ।
अदृश्यत तदा तत्र पुनरुन्मज्जितोऽन्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Splitting the earth, he plunged into the waters again; then he was seen surfacing again elsewhere.

verses.text:
सोऽवतीर्य पुनस्तस्थौ रथे हेमपरिष्कृते ।
क्षितिं द्यां च दिशश्चैव माययावृत्य दंशितः ॥

meaning.en: Then, coming down, he stood again in his gold-adorned chariot, armored, having covered earth, sky and the quarters with illusion.

verses.text:
गत्वा कर्णरथाभ्याशं विचलत्कुण्डलाननः ।
प्राह वाक्यमसंभ्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Going near Karna's chariot, with earrings swinging on his face, he spoke unshaken to the charioteer's son, O lord of the people.

verses.text:
तिष्ठेदानीं न मे जीवन्सूतपुत्र गमिष्यसि ।
युद्धश्रद्धामहं तेऽद्य विनेष्यामि रणाजिरे ॥

meaning.en: "Stand now, charioteer's son; you will not go from me alive. Today in this battlefield I will cure your appetite for fighting."

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा रोषताम्राक्षं रक्षः क्रूरपराक्रमम् ।
उत्पपातान्तरिक्षं च जहास च सुविस्वरम् ।
कर्णमभ्याहनच्चैव गजेन्द्रमिव केसरी ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the rakshasa, cruel in valor, his eyes red with rage, leapt into the sky, laughed loudly and struck Karna like a lion an elephant.

verses.text:
रथाक्षमात्रैरिषुभिरभ्यवर्षद्घटोत्कचः ।
रथिनामृषभं कर्णं धाराभिरिव तोयदः ।
शरवृष्टिं च तां कर्णो दूरप्राप्तामशातयत् ॥

meaning.en: Ghatotkacha showered arrows as long as chariot axles on Karna, bull among charioteers, like a cloud in streams; and Karna cut that rain of arrows down while it was still far off.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा च विहतां मायां कर्णेन भरतर्षभ ।
घटोत्कचस्ततो मायां ससर्जान्तर्हितः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his illusion destroyed by Karna, best of Bharatas, Ghatotkacha, hidden, made illusion again.

verses.text:
सोऽभवद्गिरिरित्युच्चः शिखरैस्तरुसंकटैः ।
शूलप्रासासिमुसलजलप्रस्रवणो महान् ॥

meaning.en: He became a great mountain, with peaks thick with trees, streaming with spears, lances, swords and clubs like water.

verses.text:
तमञ्जनचयप्रख्यं कर्णो दृष्ट्वा महीधरम् ।
प्रपातैरायुधान्युग्राण्युद्वहन्तं न चुक्षुभे ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that mountain like a heap of collyrium, bearing fierce weapons in its falls, Karna was not shaken.

verses.text:
स्मयन्निव ततः कर्णो दिव्यमस्त्रमुदीरयत् ।
ततः सोऽस्त्रेण शैलेन्द्रो विक्षिप्तो वै व्यनश्यत ॥

meaning.en: Then, smiling as it were, Karna called up a divine weapon; and that king of mountains, struck by the weapon, vanished.

verses.text:
ततः स तोयदो भूत्वा नीलः सेन्द्रायुधो दिवि ।
अश्मवृष्टिभिरत्युग्रः सूतपुत्रमवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: Then he became a dark cloud in the sky with a rainbow, and, most terrible, showered the charioteer's son with rains of stones.

verses.text:
अथ संधाय वायव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः ।
व्यधमत्कालमेघं तं कर्णो वैकर्तनो वृषा ॥

meaning.en: Then the best of those who know weapons, Karna, Vikartana's son, the bull, fitted the Vayavya weapon and dispersed that black cloud.

verses.text:
स मार्गणगणैः कर्णो दिशः प्रच्छाद्य सर्वशः ।
जघानास्त्रं महाराज घटोत्कचसमीरितम् ॥

meaning.en: Karna, covering all quarters with swarms of arrows, destroyed the weapon sent by Ghatotkacha, great king.

verses.text:
ततः प्रहस्य समरे भैमसेनिर्महाबलः ।
प्रादुश्चक्रे महामायां कर्णं प्रति महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima's son, the very strong, smiling in the battle, again produced great illusion against the great warrior Karna.

verses.text:
स दृष्ट्वा पुनरायान्तं रथेन रथिनां वरम् ।
घटोत्कचमसंभ्रान्तं राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the best of charioteers, Ghatotkacha, come again in his chariot, unshaken and surrounded by many rakshasas,

verses.text:
सिंहशार्दूलसदृशैर्मत्तद्विरदविक्रमैः ।
गजस्थैश्च रथस्थैश्च वाजिपृष्ठगतैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: like lions and tigers, with the strength of rutting elephants, on elephants, in chariots and on horseback,

verses.text:
नानाशस्त्रधरैर्घोरैर्नानाकवचभूषणैः ।
वृतं घटोत्कचं क्रूरैर्मरुद्भिरिव वासवम् ।
दृष्ट्वा कर्णो महेष्वासो योधयामास राक्षसम् ॥

meaning.en: bearing various weapons, dreadful, with various armors and ornaments, Ghatotkacha surrounded by cruel ones as Indra by the Maruts, the great archer Karna fought the rakshasa.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचस्ततः कर्णं विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः ।
ननाद भैरवं नादं भीषयन्सर्वपार्थिवान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Ghatotkacha, having pierced Karna with five swift arrows, gave a terrible roar, frightening all the kings.

verses.text:
भूयश्चाञ्जलिकेनाथ समार्गणगणं महत् ।
कर्णहस्तस्थितं चापं चिच्छेदाशु घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: Then with an anjalika arrow, with a great flock of arrows, Ghatotkacha quickly cut the bow in Karna's hand.

verses.text:
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय दृढं भारसहं महत् ।
व्यकर्षत बलात्कर्ण इन्द्रायुधमिवोच्छ्रितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then taking another firm, great bow that could bear the strain, Karna pulled it back with force like a lifted rainbow.

verses.text:
ततः कर्णो महाराज प्रेषयामास सायकान् ।
सुवर्णपुङ्खाञ्शत्रुघ्नान्खचरान्राक्षसान्प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, great king, sent gold-feathered, enemy-killing arrows at the rakshasas moving in the sky.

verses.text:
तद्बाणैरर्दितं यूथं रक्षसां पीनवक्षसाम् ।
सिंहेनेवार्दितं वन्यं गजानामाकुलं कुलम् ॥

meaning.en: Struck by his arrows, the throng of broad-chested rakshasas was shattered like a herd of elephants in the forest attacked by a lion.

verses.text:
विधम्य राक्षसान्बाणैः साश्वसूतगजान्विभुः ।
ददाह भगवान्वह्निर्भूतानीव युगक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Having destroyed the rakshasas with arrows along with their horses, charioteers and elephants, the lord burned them like the blessed fire consuming beings at the end of an age.

verses.text:
स हत्वा राक्षसीं सेनां शुशुभे सूतनन्दनः ।
पुरेव त्रिपुरं दग्ध्वा दिवि देवो महेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Having killed the rakshasa army, the charioteer's son shone like the god Maheshvara after burning Tripura in heaven.

verses.text:
तेषु राजसहस्रेषु पाण्डवेयेषु मारिष ।
नैनं निरीक्षितुमपि कश्चिच्छक्नोति पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: Among those thousands of kings of the Pandava side, O king, no one could even look at him,

verses.text:
ऋते घटोत्कचाद्राजन्राक्षसेन्द्रान्महाबलात् ।
भीमवीर्यबलोपेतात्क्रुद्धाद्वैवस्वतादिव ॥

meaning.en: except Ghatotkacha, the mighty rakshasa lord, endowed with Bhima's strength and valor, angry like Yama.

verses.text:
तस्य क्रुद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां पावकः समजायत ।
महोल्काभ्यां यथा राजन्सार्चिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः ॥

meaning.en: From the eyes of the angry one fire was born, like drops of oil falling with flame from two great meteors.

verses.text:
तलं तलेन संहत्य संदश्य दशनच्छदम् ।
रथमास्थाय च पुनर्मायया निर्मितं पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Striking palm on palm and biting his lip, he mounted again a chariot made by illusion,

verses.text:
युक्तं गजनिभैर्वाहैः पिशाचवदनैः खरैः ।
स सूतमब्रवीत्क्रुद्धः सूतपुत्राय मा वह ॥

meaning.en: drawn by elephant-like mounts, donkeys with faces of pishachas. Angry, he told his charioteer: "Take me to the charioteer's son."

verses.text:
स ययौ घोररूपेण रथेन रथिनां वरः ।
द्वैरथं सूतपुत्रेण पुनरेव विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: He went in that dreadful chariot, best of charioteers, again to single combat with the charioteer's son, O lord of the people.

verses.text:
स चिक्षेप पुनः क्रुद्धः सूतपुत्राय राक्षसः ।
अष्टचक्रां महाघोरामशनिं रुद्रनिर्मिताम् ॥

meaning.en: In anger the rakshasa hurled at the charioteer's son a terrible eight-wheeled thunderbolt made by Rudra.

verses.text:
तामवप्लुत्य जग्राह कर्णो न्यस्य रथे धनुः ।
चिक्षेप चैनां तस्यैव स्यन्दनात्सोऽवपुप्लुवे ॥

meaning.en: Leaping up, Karna caught it, setting down his bow in the chariot, and hurled it back at him; he leapt away from his chariot.

verses.text:
साश्वसूतध्वजं यानं भस्म कृत्वा महाप्रभा ।
विवेश वसुधां भित्त्वा सुरास्तत्र विसिस्मियुः ॥

meaning.en: Reducing the chariot with its horses, charioteer and banner to ash, the greatly bright weapon entered the earth, splitting it, and the gods were amazed there.

verses.text:
कर्णं तु सर्वभूतानि पूजयामासुरञ्जसा ।
यदवप्लुत्य जग्राह देवसृष्टां महाशनिम् ॥

meaning.en: All beings honored Karna directly, for leaping up he had caught the great bolt made by the gods.

verses.text:
एवं कृत्वा रणे कर्ण आरुरोह रथं पुनः ।
ततो मुमोच नाराचान्सूतपुत्रः परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: Having done this in battle, Karna mounted his chariot again, and then the charioteer's son, tormentor of foes, let loose iron arrows.

verses.text:
अशक्यं कर्तुमन्येन सर्वभूतेषु मानद ।
यदकार्षीत्तदा कर्णः संग्रामे भीमदर्शने ॥

meaning.en: What Karna did then in that fearful battle could not be done by any other among all beings, honored one.

verses.text:
स हन्यमानो नाराचैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतः ।
गन्धर्वनगराकारः पुनरन्तरधीयत ॥

meaning.en: Struck by iron arrows like a mountain by streams of rain, he, like a gandharva city, vanished again.

verses.text:
एवं स वै महामायो मायया लाघवेन च ।
अस्त्राणि तानि दिव्यानि जघान रिपुसूदनः ॥

meaning.en: Thus that great illusionist, slayer of foes, with illusion and quickness destroyed those divine weapons.

verses.text:
निहन्यमानेष्वस्त्रेषु मायया तेन रक्षसा ।
असंभ्रान्तस्ततः कर्णस्तद्रक्षः प्रत्ययुध्यत ॥

meaning.en: When the weapons were being destroyed by that rakshasa's illusion, Karna, unshaken, fought that rakshasa.

verses.text:
ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज भैमसेनिर्महाबलः ।
चकार बहुधात्मानं भीषयाणो नराधिपान् ॥

meaning.en: Then, great king, the very strong son of Bhima, enraged, made himself many, frightening the kings.

verses.text:
ततो दिग्भ्यः समापेतुः सिंहव्याघ्रतरक्षवः ।
अग्निजिह्वाश्च भुजगा विहगाश्चाप्ययोमुखाः ॥

meaning.en: Then lions, tigers, hyenas, serpents with tongues of fire and birds with iron beaks rushed from all sides.

verses.text:
स कीर्यमाणो निशितैः कर्णचापच्युतैः शरैः ।
नगराद्रिवनप्रख्यस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥

meaning.en: Struck by sharp arrows shot from Karna's bow, he looked like a city, mountain or forest and vanished on the spot.

verses.text:
राक्षसाश्च पिशाचाश्च यातुधानाः शलावृकाः ।
ते कर्णं भक्षयिष्यन्तः सर्वतः समुपाद्रवन् ।
अथैनं वाग्भिरुग्राभिस्त्रासयां चक्रिरे तदा ॥

meaning.en: Rakshasas, pishachas, yatudhanas and wolves, to eat Karna, ran at him from all sides, and terrified him then with fierce words.

verses.text:
उद्यतैर्बहुभिर्घोरैरायुधैः शोणितोक्षितैः ।
तेषामनेकैरेकैकं कर्णो विव्याध चाशुगैः ॥

meaning.en: With many raised dreadful weapons smeared with blood, Karna pierced them one by one, each with several swift arrows.

verses.text:
प्रतिहत्य तु तां मायां दिव्येनास्त्रेण राक्षसीम् ।
आजघान हयानस्य शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: Having destroyed that rakshasa illusion with a divine weapon, he struck his horses with bent-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
ते भग्ना विकृताङ्गाश्च छिन्नपृष्ठाश्च सायकैः ।
वसुधामन्वपद्यन्त पश्यतस्तस्य रक्षसः ॥

meaning.en: Broken, with deformed limbs and backs cut by arrows, they fell to the earth while the rakshasa looked on.

verses.text:
स भग्नमायो हैडिम्बः कर्णं वैकर्तनं ततः ।
एष ते विदधे मृत्युमित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत ॥

meaning.en: With his illusion shattered, Hidimba's son then said to Karna, Vikartana's son, "I make this your death," and vanished.
